title: OEIS Open: How many conjectures can language models turn into theorems?
abstract: arXiv:2608.11941v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We construct OEIS Open, a benchmark based on 492 open mathematical conjectures from the OEIS, formalized in Lean by Tsoukalas et al. Whereas these conjectures had previously been attempted only with a bespoke agent, our open-source evaluation code runs any generic language model (LM) against them, and is secure against LM cheating attempts. We find that LMs equipped with a minimal set of tools resolve 147 of these conjectures with a budget of \$50 per attempt, scoring 30% on OEIS Open. OEIS Open Lite is a random subset of 100 conjectures for cheaper evaluation. When evaluated with a budget of \$200 per attempt, the best current LM scores 44% on OEIS Open Lite. Giving LMs access to the mathematics literature via 476,000 papers from arXiv did not increase performance on OEIS Open Lite, and nor did using more sophisticated agent loops. translated_title: OEIS Open：语言模型能将多少猜想转化为定理？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11941v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们构建了OEIS Open，这是一个基于OEIS中492个开放数学猜想的基准测试，由Tsoukalas等人用Lean形式化。这些猜想此前仅通过定制代理尝试解决，而我们的开源评估代码可运行任何通用语言模型（LM）并防止LM作弊。我们发现，配备最简工具集的LM在每次尝试预算50美元的情况下解决了其中147个猜想，在OEIS Open上得分30%。OEIS Open Lite是100个猜想的随机子集，用于更经济的评估。当每次尝试预算为200美元时，当前最佳LM在OEIS Open Lite上得分44%。通过arXiv上的476,000篇论文为LM提供数学文献访问并未提高其在OEIS Open Lite上的表现，使用更复杂的代理循环也无济于事。本工作中涵盖的猜想数学意义不确定，且大多数可能已被忽略。
tldr: 本论文构建了OEIS Open基准，基于492个Lean形式化的OEIS猜想，发现通用语言模型在有限预算下可解决约30%的猜想，但增加文献访问或复杂代理并未提升性能。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs the OEIS Open benchmark based on 492 Lean-formalized OEIS conjectures, finding that generic language models can solve about 30% with limited budgets, while adding literature access or sophisticated agents does not improve performance.
